description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing a git HTTP backend server implementation, with functions to simulate HTTP GET and POST requests, run backend commands, and check for expected responses.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Runs the git http-backend command with specified parameters, redirecting output to files for testing.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP GET request to the backend and verifies the response matches expectations.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP POST request and checks the backend response.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Checks whether the backend response indicates an aliased path or not, based on the input parameter.
